description: If every atom of the finite clause set \(\Gamma\) lies in a finite set \(S\), some saturation run reaches a clause set closed under resolution after at most \(|\mathcal C(S)|-|\Gamma|\) steps, where \(\mathcal C(S)\) is the finite set of all clauses using literals on \(S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.saturation_exists.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α) (hs : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Supported S Γ) :
  ∃ k Δ,
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.SaturationRun k Γ Δ ∧
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Closed Δ ∧
        k ≤ (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.availableClauses S).card - Finset.card Γ
